source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SSD NVMe LED Check - Locate
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID locate LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot
2. Select NVMe adapter and locate NVMe SSD
3. Check locate LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: storcli/sas3ircu/ssacli (RAID/HBA tool) or ipmitool for BMC LED

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires operator confirmation but does not prove correct-bay selection and uses an undocumented generic raw command.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds exact adapter/SSD/bay mapping, validated locate endpoint, visual evidence and state restoration.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 baseline record exists; source, script reference and V2 were reviewed independently.

original_test_intent: Verify that invoking the approved NVMe RAID/adapter locate function for a selected SSD illuminates only the platform-defined locate indicator on the exact physical bay and that the indicator can be returned to its normal state.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts and maps the SSD, automation sends the vendor-approved locate-on request for the immutable controller/device identifier, the operator visually records the correct bay LED and absence of unintended indicators, then the approved locate-off/restoration action is issued and verified.
manual_activity: Physical SSD insertion and visual confirmation that the intended physical locate LED—and no wrong bay—responds are core acceptance. The agent may issue an approved command and collect status but cannot claim the visual result, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
required_inputs: Exact controller/adapter identifier, SSD serial/namespace and physical bay map
Locate LED applicability, color/pattern/timing and exclusive-bay expectation
Reviewed internal script and vendor-supported locate-on/off commands/version
Qualified operator and synchronized photo/video checklist
Safe final indicator state and management/system log scope
safety_requirements: Do not issue any raw/vendor command until its platform-specific target and on/off semantics are validated.
Bind the command to the exact immutable SSD/controller identifier; stop if mapping is ambiguous or another bay responds.
Do not let locate state persist unintentionally; restore it only with the approved off procedure and verify visually.
Preserve wrong-bay or unexpected-state evidence; do not auto-retry, fan out across drives or toggle blindly.
agent_execution_scope: Validate mapping, script/endpoint and expected LED/restoration behavior; capture baseline status.
After approval, send one exact locate-on request, capture response/status/logs, and later send the approved locate-off only after operator evidence.
Correlate operator-attributed photos/video with command timing and report Tool Result without asserting visual acceptance.
engineer_actions: Approve the SSD/bay mapping, vendor locate endpoint and final-state plan.
Perform/attest insertion and visually confirm correct and exclusive locate LED response and restoration.
Review command/physical evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The undocumented raw `0x3a 0x0e...` command is rejected because its target and state semantics are unknown; `lsblk` cannot prove which physical LED lit. The referenced project script requires content review.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the validated controller/vendor locate-on and locate-off interface bound to the selected SSD, with operator observation as primary acceptance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SSD insertion, adapter selection, locate invocation/LED check, referenced script and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: IDENTITY-BOUND LOCATE CONTROL WITH MANUAL VISUAL PROOF
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed controller-to-bay map and reviewed locate script, capture request/response timestamps and synchronized wide-frame video proving only the intended bay indicates, followed by off-state restoration.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record adapter/controller/BMC/backplane firmware, SSD firmware and script/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor locate-command documentation and platform LED specification plus the referenced internal script must be supplied.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target-safe command validation, exclusive-bay evidence and restoration without replacing visual inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; correct physical locate response remains mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mapping, spec and supported on/off commands.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful command response cannot prove correct physical bay indication.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its supported locate interface and pattern. Evidence must identify the exact selected SSD and bay; one bay result cannot be generalized to all drives unless the plan explicitly covers each.
expected_evidence: Controller/adapter/SSD/namespace/bay map, locate specification, reviewed script/tool and authorization
Locate-on request/response and operator-attributed synchronized evidence showing only the intended bay
Locate-off/restoration response and visual idle-state proof
Management/device/system/BMC logs, any wrong-bay behavior, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require locate behavior as defined by the platform specification. Missing endpoint/spec is readiness, not contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The locate purpose is clear. Mapping/tool/spec are readiness inputs; physical observation remains MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains command/status assistance but rejects its undocumented raw endpoint and PARTIAL label.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains mapping, endpoint and restoration controls while applying MANUAL ONLY to the visual core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds exclusive-bay proof, immutable identity binding and explicit locate-off evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents a wrong-bay indication or unsupported raw command from being reported as locate success and ensures the indicator is restored.
independent_technical_reasoning: Locate control may be electronically automatable, but the accepted outcome is which physical bay LED illuminates. That visual/spatial fact requires human observation, making the complete case MANUAL ONLY.
